title: SSL Inspection rule wire notes: Kerberos road warriors, ZPA segments and predefined rules
aliases: predefined ssl inspection rules cannot be deleted terraform

prose.text: A few SSL Inspection rule settings are not covered by the console criteria. The nested action shape is in [[zia.ssl-inspection.api-shape]] and the rule inventory and cap in [[zia.ssl-inspection.rules]].

checks.do: Whether a predefined SSL Inspection rule is being deleted, which the provider does not support.
Whether the rule was meant to cover remote PAC users on Kerberos, which is its own SSL Inspection rule setting.

road-warrior-kerberos.statement: The SSL Inspection rule setting road_warrior_for_kerberos applies the rule to remote users that use PAC with Kerberos authentication.

quotes: road_warrior_for_kerberos (bool): The rule is applied to remote users that use PAC with Kerberos authentication.

zpa-app-segments.statement: An SSL Inspection rule can name ZPA application segments that have Source IP Anchoring enabled.

quotes: zpa_app_segments (list): List of Source IP Anchoring-enabled ZPA Application Segments

predefined-not-destroyable.statement: Default and predefined rules cannot be deleted; predefined ones can be imported and reordered, but destroying one fails; default rules should not be imported.

quotes: Zscaler SSL Inspection rules contain default and predefined rules which cannot be deleted.
Predefined rules can be managed via the Terraform provider for reordering purposes; however, `destroy` operations are not supported for predefined rules
DO NOT import or manage Default Rules.
The import of `predefined` rules is still possible in case you want o have them under the Terraform management; however, remember that these rules cannot be deleted.

mcp-sharepoint-enum-report.statement: MCP server issue #56 reported that adding SharePoint Online to an SSL inspection rule returned no response because the SSL inspection API accepts only internal enum strings such as ONEDRIVE; it was closed as completed on 2026-04-28 with a reply from a member of the repository's organization, signed Zscaler DevRel, to upgrade to v0.10.5.

quotes: the SSL inspection API only accepts Zscaler's internal enum strings (like ONEDRIVE, ONEDRIVE_PERSONAL)
## Comment (MEMBER, 2026-04-28) Upgrade to the latest version of the mcp server v0.10.5 Zscaler DevRel
When trying to add "Sharepoint Online" (ID 655377) into existing SSL inspection rule, the api response is none.
`"Sharepoint Online"` are silently translated to the canonical enums the API requires (`GOOGLE_DRIVE`, `ONEDRIVE`, `SHAREPOINT_ONLINE`)

mcp-sharepoint-enum-report.conditions: The reply names v0.10.5 while the auto-resolution entry sits in the 0.11.0 section; the changelog does not tie the entry to the issue.
